item.title: Assam to Receive ₹617.98 Cr. for Roads, ₹129.74 Cr. for Bridges, Gadkari Announces
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam is set to receive ₹747.72 crore from the central government for major infrastructure development, including ₹617.98 crore for 10 road projects under the Central Road Infrastructure Fund (CRIF) Scheme and ₹129.74 crore for 16 bridge projects under the CRIF Setu Bandhan Scheme. item.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Seva Teerth, Kartavya Bhavan Buildings
item.description: GUWAHATI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday, February 13, formally inaugurated the Seva Teerth complex and Kartavya Bhavan-1 & 2 in New Delhi, marking a transformative milestone in India’s administrative governance architecture. item.title: Riyan Parag Likely to be Named as Rajasthan Royals’ New Captain: Reports
item.description: GUWAHATI: India all-rounder Riyan Parag is set to be announced as the new captain of Rajasthan Royals ahead of IPL 2026. According to reports, the franchise considered options including Yashasvi Jaiswal, Dhruv Jurel, and veteran Ravindra Jadeja, but ultimately chose Parag, who has been with the Royals since his IPL debut in 2019. item.title: Bridge Over Lohit River Connecting Majuli and Lakhimpur Districts Inaugurated, Other Infrastructure Projects Unveiled
item.description: GUWAHATI: A 702-metre-long bridge over the Lohit river at Dhunaguri, Majuli, was inaugurated with the aim of improving connectivity between the districts of Majuli and Lakhimpur. The new link is expected to significantly ease travel and access to essential services in the river island district. item.title: Gauhati HC Allows Ancillary Work on ₹498-Crore Kamakhya Corridor, Bars Any Alteration to Temple Structure
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Gauhati High Court has permitted the Assam government to proceed with limited preparatory and ancillary work under the ₹498-crore Kamakhya Corridor project, while firmly directing that the main shrine remain untouched.
